summary.text: Kathryn Larson is the independent candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 1B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Cornel Rasor. A consultant, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that her priorities are local decision-making, working infrastructure and affordability.

paragraphs.text: Kathryn Larson was born in Dallas, Texas, graduated from Highland Park High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Southern Methodist University in 1980.

Her career experience includes work as a consultant, and she has been affiliated with ArtWorks, the Community Assistance League, Pend Oreille Pedalers, Worth of a Woman, the Idaho Trails Association and the Pend Oreille Economic Partnership.
In her survey she said she specialized in identifying and clearing bottlenecks for organizations and moved to North Idaho in 2015.
Larson also ran in the 2024 general election for District 1B, which incumbent Cornel Rasor won.

In her 2026 survey she said she wants to protect rural health care access and public lands, maintain schools and transportation, and keep the state from shifting costs onto counties, cities and school districts.
